rule.name: HandSplitHttpHeader
rule.message: This splits a structured header by hand, which breaks on quoted values, whitespace around separators and quality weights. Parse it instead: MediaType.parseMediaType(value) or MediaType.parseMediaTypes(value) for Content-Type and Accept, ContentDisposition.parse(value), HttpCookie.parse(value) or the servlet cookie API for cookies. A library that is itself the parser takes an exceptions entry.
